data.title: Poland vs Romania Prediction: The "Red-Whites" will achieve a long-awaited victory - Telecom Asia Sport
data.content: ## Poland vs Romania: Prediction for the match on 2 October 2026. On October 2, 2026, the UEFA Nations League match between Poland and Romania will take place at the Narodowy Stadium in Warsaw. ## Poland vs Romania Prediction for October 2. In the Nations League, Poland is in League B, where the goal is clear – to win the group and return to the elite. Poland finished second in their qualifying group for the 2026 World Cup, leading them to the playoffs for a chance to qualify. Betting on Poland to win is available at odds of 1.55 with 1xBet. Betting on Poland's total to be over 1.5 goals is available at odds of 1.65 with Betway. Betting on over 2.5 goals is available at odds of 1.80 with Paripesa. Betting on Romania's total to be over 0.5 goals is available at odds of 1.65 with Betway.
